Card Q&A.q: If one of the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [On Play] effect is a Tamer card or Option card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait, can I add that card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. This effect can interrupt the removal of a card from the battle area, therefore by deleting 1 of your other Digimon with the [D-Brigade] trait, this card will be prevented from being placed in your other Digimon's digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's inherited effect activate when an opponent's effect would place a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards in another of my Digimon's digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "When [...] would [...] leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the top or bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by one of your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon with the [D-Brigade] trait, prevent it from leaving.
